status: POST-HOC DIAGNOSTICS OF A FAILED GATE. R7 and representation-free quantities only; R1-R6 sealed. The sensitivity block is exploratory and is NOT the gate's outcome.

gate_as_registered.rule: R7 concept-consistent or (on-only) for >= 50% of powered concepts (pre-registration S7 C1; amendment 2 B6)

IIA.meaning: share of pairs whose patched legal decision lands in the target set

r0.meaning: share of pairs whose UNPATCHED base decision already lands in the target set

flip_rate.meaning: share of pairs whose legal decision changes at all under the patch

target_margin.meaning: change in the best target logit minus the mean change of the other legal actions

ceiling.meaning: IIA* of the network's own decision on the source (full-activation patch)

network_own_iia_star.meaning: agreement of the patched decision with the network's decision on the source, chance-corrected by base-vs-source agreement

leak.meaning: specificity pairs: rise in P(play the concept's cell) under the patch
